name: Chhanar Jalebi
ingredients: Ghee or vegetable oil for deep frying
instructions: 1. Knead the chhana, maida, suji, and baking powder together until completely smooth and lump-free.
2. Divide the dough into small portions and roll them into thin cylinders, then join the ends to form jalebi shapes.
3. Prepare a sugar syrup by boiling sugar and water with cardamom until it reaches a thin, sticky consistency.
4. Heat ghee in a pan and deep-fry the shaped coils on low to medium heat until they turn deep golden brown.
5. Immediately transfer the fried jalebis into the warm sugar syrup and let them soak for at least 30 minutes before serving.
description: Chhanar Jalebi is a decadent Bengali dessert that differs from the North Indian flour-based jalebi by using chhana as the base. It is a beloved specialty often found in traditional sweet shops (mishti dokan) in West Bengal, celebrated for its rich, melt-in-the-mouth texture and subtle cardamom flavor.
